# How Big Is the ANTISCAM Dataset? A Detailed Assessment of Corpus Size, Composition, and Annotation Scope

## Executive Summary

The ANTISCAM dataset is a human–human anti-scam dialogue corpus introduced by Yu Li, Kun Qian, Weiyan Shi, and Zhou Yu of the University of California, Davis, in the paper *End-to-End Trainable Non-Collaborative Dialog System* ([Yu et al., 2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/1911.10742)).
